schema_note: English editions we want for training or alignment but cannot public-GET without a login, borrow, or storefront. Every wall has a url to open later. Drop files into ~/versed-translator-data/train-english/ (in-copyright) or pd-english/ (US PD). Do not add Scribd/libgen/Hathi downloaders. Hosting a scan is not a sublicense.

fields.url: Primary page to open when you have login, borrow, or purchase access.
fields.urls: Optional extra pages (IA borrow copies, other volumes, reprints to reject).
fields.status: blocked | fetched | partial. fetched = we got a public GET elsewhere; keep the wall so the storefront is not re-scraped. partial = excerpt on disk, full book still walled.

walls.what: Library of Arabic Literature English volumes
walls.openiti: per title; Arabic PDFs are already free on the LAL site
walls.wall: NYU Press storefront. Site posts Arabic PDFs only.
walls.align_if_dropped: facing-page LAL editions are paragraph-alignable to the free Arabic PDF, and to OpenITI if the LAL Arabic matches the OpenITI witness

walls.what: Whatever is only on Scribd or libgen (Arberry Seven Odes was one)
walls.wall: login/paywall. Not a public GET. Do not scrape. Arberry 1957 Seven Odes is already on disk from muslimphilosophy.com.

walls.what: IA borrow-only scans (encrypted.pdf / LCP epub). Example: sevenodesfirstch0000ajar
walls.wall: IA library login + 14-day loan. djvu.txt 403s. 1970+ reprints here are train-only even after a loan; Kelley/Gryphon Gruner reprints are not the 1930 Luzac PD drop.

walls.what: HathiTrust full-view PD books whose PDF download wants a partner login. Prendergast mdp.39015004171925 (we have a DLI OCR instead). Gairdner 1924 Mishkat HT PDF still walls; HTML transcription is now on disk.
walls.wall: HT full view is often readable; PDF/OCR dump may need university login. Do not dump the 2,555 Hathi catalog rows.
walls.align_if_dropped: Gairdner 1924 RAS is in pd-english from ghazali.org HTML. IA 1952 reprint and Buchman 1998 remain traps.

walls.what: O. Cameron Gruner, A Treatise on the Canon of Medicine of Avicenna (Luzac, London, 1930) — Book 1 only
walls.wall: US PD as of 1 Jan 2026 (95-year term). Hathi dump has no 1930 Luzac row — only 1984 Classics of Medicine Library reprints (mdp.39015059983588 / mdp.39015029949115, rights_date 1984, deny/ic). Reject those. Reject IA 1970 Kelley borrow (treatiseoncanono0000avic) and the AMS 1973 stream. Wellcome has the 1930 physical. Penn Arcadian Library Online is a site-license of the 1930 sheets. Partner PDF of the 1930 Luzac original is the drop we want.
walls.align_if_dropped: Book 1 of the Qanun; medicine is an empty genre. Drop as ~/versed-translator-data/pd-english/gruner_canon_1930.pdf (or djvu.txt). Reject 1970 Kelley and 1984 Gryphon/Classics of Medicine reprints.

walls.what: Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930). US PD as of 1 Jan 2026.
walls.wall: fetched. Wikimedia Commons 1930 Knopf scan is a public PDF GET. Wikisource HTML is incomplete. Gutenberg 16955 mixes Pickthall with Yusuf Ali 1934 — do not fetch that bundle.
walls.align_if_dropped: sura/ayah, canonical order, modern English. Better MT target than Palmer/Rodwell.

walls.what: H.A.R. Gibb, Travels of Ibn Battuta, Hakluyt Society (1958–)
walls.wall: in copyright. Hakluyt / Routledge / T&F storefront. Lee 1829 on disk is an abridgement — poor page match to full OpenITI Rihla.
walls.align_if_dropped: best page-level pair for the Rihla; train_ok only

walls.what: SUNY 40-volume History of al-Tabari
walls.wall: in copyright. No public GET of the SUNY volumes. IA vol. 1 (historyofaltabar0001abar, 1988) is borrow-only. There is no PD English of the History either — that only blocks redistribute_ok, not training.

walls.what: Franz Rosenthal, The Muqaddimah (1958, renewed)
walls.wall: in copyright. Princeton/Bollingen storefront. Traditional Hikma public PDF GET is already in train-english (eval_internal, do not ship). IA 2005 abridgement is borrow-only. ATHAR English is this edition verbatim.
walls.align_if_dropped: chapter/section numbers; Arabic is the preface of Tarikh

walls.what: A. Guillaume, The Life of Muhammad (1955)
walls.wall: in copyright. OUP storefront. IA bwb_S0-AVO-331 is a 1968 borrow. Unrestricted IA uploads of this title look like unauthorized copies — do not treat them as a public GET. Edwardes 1964 is an abridgement trap.
walls.align_if_dropped: Wüstenfeld page numbers printed in Guillaume

walls.what: Arberry, The Ring of the Dove (Ibn Hazm Tawq al-Hamama)
walls.wall: fetched. Public HTML GET of the Luzac Arberry translation at muslimphilosophy.com. In copyright — train-english only. IA 1994 Luzac reprint is borrow-only.

walls.what: Serjeant English of al-Jahiz Kitab al-Bukhala (Garnet 1997)
walls.wall: in copyright. Garnet / Center for Muslim Contribution to Civilization. IA 2000 reprint is borrow-only. No PD English found.

walls.what: Nabih Amin Faris, The Book of Idols (Princeton 1952)
walls.wall: fetched. Public HTML GET at ai-deutschland.de/Books/Al-Kalbi/ (27 chapter pages). In copyright — train-english only, never pd-english.
walls.align_if_dropped: named idol chapters (Allat, Uzza, Manah…). Short book. train_ok only. ATHAR English is this edition.

walls.what: sacred-texts.com HTML (Prendergast Hamadhani, hanged poems)
walls.wall: Cloudflare bot check. We fetched Hamadhani from IA instead.

walls.what: Brill, Cambridge Core, JSTOR, Project MUSE, De Gruyter ebooks
walls.wall: institutional login. Includes Faris 1952 PDF at De Gruyter (we have the HTML GET instead).
walls.align_if_dropped: train_ok unless the license is CC0/BY/BY-SA

walls.what: Bayard Dodge, The Fihrist of al-Nadim (Columbia, 1970), 2 vols
walls.wall: in copyright. Columbia storefront. IA fihristofalnadim0000ibna is a 1970 borrow. muslimphilosophy nad-phil.pdf is a philosophy-chapter extract already in train-english — not the whole catalogue.
walls.align_if_dropped: ten discourses / chapter heads of the Fihrist

walls.what: R.J.C. Broadhurst, The Travels of Ibn Jubayr (Jonathan Cape 1952; I.B. Tauris reprint)
walls.wall: in copyright. 1952 Cape / 2019 I.B. Tauris. IA 1907 Wright items are the Arabic edition, not this English. No public GET of Broadhurst found.

walls.what: Lenn E. Goodman, Ibn Tufayl's Hayy Ibn Yaqzan (Twayne 1972 / Chicago reprint)
walls.wall: in copyright. Chicago storefront. We already have Ockley 1708 (pd-english) and Fulton 1929 (train-english). Goodman is the modern literary register if you buy or borrow it.

walls.what: Majid Khadduri, Al-Shafi'i's Risala (Johns Hopkins 1961; Islamic Texts Society reprint)
walls.wall: in copyright. ITS storefront. IA bwb_C0-ABV-991 (1961) is borrow-only. LAL also has a Lowry Epistle on Legal Theory — that English is the LAL NYU Press wall, not this one.

walls.what: A.F.L. Beeston, The Epistle on Singing-Girls of Jahiz (Aris & Phillips 1980)
walls.wall: in copyright. Warminster Aris & Phillips 1980 (later Liverpool UP). Short facing edition. No public GET found.

walls.what: I.K.A. Howard, Kitab al-Irshad (Muhammadi Trust 1981)
walls.wall: in copyright. Muhammadi Trust / Tahrike Tarsile. al-islam.org does not host the full Howard book (intros/articles only; printpdf 404). No public GET of the complete English.

walls.what: Charles Pellat / D.M. Hawke, The Life and Works of Jahiz (Routledge 1969) — selected texts, not Bukhala complete
walls.wall: in copyright. Routledge & Kegan Paul 1969. Anthology via French, not a full Bukhala. Serjeant 1997 is the complete misers translation (separate wall).

walls.what: A.R. Nykl, A Book Containing the Risala Known as The Dove's Neck-Ring (Oriental Institute, 1931)
walls.wall: 1931 is still in US copyright until 1 Jan 2027 (95-year term). No public GET found. Arberry Luzac HTML is already in train-english and is the better modern English.
walls.align_if_dropped: same 30-chapter spine as Arberry; wait for PD in 2027 if you want a redistribute_ok Dove

walls.what: Later reprints of Hitti's 1929 Usama (Princeton 1964/1987/2000). The 1929 original is already in pd-english.
walls.wall: IA borrow-only reprints. Do not replace the 1929 PD file with a 1987/2000 scan.
